name: hosted
description: Commands and helpers that only work on a server 5dive built, because they talk to 5dive's own servers as that server: `5dive partner hire` (a partner client's agent hires a colleague from the partner's catalogue) and the native-push helper agents' hooks call when they fail. 5dive's install adds it on every server 5dive built; a self-hosted server has no use for it.

verbs.name: partner
verbs.summary: on a partner's server: hire a colleague from the partner's catalogue
